title: Saturday with Dana
notes: Keeping the Saturday promise. Dana owns her response: she's glad you came, and that's not the same as everything being fixed. Claude's draft.
Her trust goes up here because she decides it does, not because you earned a point.

booth.speaker: Dana
text: Dana's already in the window booth. She looks up when the bell goes. "You came." It isn't a question.
[Marlene] pours two coffees without asking either of you.

choices.label: "I said I would."
result: "You said that last time too." She smiles anyway. "Sit."

choices.label: "Sorry about last time."
result: She shrugs. "You're here now. That's the part I can use."

text: She tells you about her week. Her car, the battery, her sister. You tell her about Ray and the slab and the cans, which is a dumber story than you thought, and she laughs at it anyway.
An hour goes. It's the first one in a while that didn't go somewhere.
effects: proof:ownership:Kept the Saturday promise to Dana.

after.speaker: Dana
text: "Same time next month?" She says it into her coffee, like it's nothing.

choices.label: "Yeah."
choices.record: Promise made: breakfast with Dana next month.

choices.label: "Let me see how the month goes."
